562748.Description: In Fleet Glide Galaxy, collect the Power Star "Fastest Feathers in the Galaxy" after finishing the race with 6 HP
562748.Author: KiwiTaco

562749.Title: Wall Kicks Will Work
562749.Description: In Bowser Jr.'s Boom Bunker, collect the Grand Star "Bowser Jr.'s Boomsday Machine" without creating more than 4 clouds during the Boomsday Machine battle
562749.Author: KiwiTaco

562755.Title: Rock and Roll
562755.Description: In Melty Monster Galaxy, collect the Power Star "A Stroll Down Rolling Lane" with at least 150 Star Bits and without dying
562755.Author: KiwiTaco

562756.Title: Desert Rush
562756.Description: In Clockwork Ruins Galaxy, collect the Power Star "The Ledge Hammer Trap" in under 00:40.00
562756.Author: KiwiTaco

562757.Title: Now What?
562757.Description: In Throwback Galaxy, clear the teleporter gauntlet and collect the 3 1-Up Mushrooms without entering the teleporter
562757.Author: KiwiTaco

562758.Title: Jump Out of Orbit
562758.Description: In Battle Belt Galaxy, collect any Power Star without using the Fire Flower
562758.Author: KiwiTaco

562759.Title: Scrabbling for Change
562759.Description: In Flash Black Galaxy, collect the Power Star "Dark Octo-Army Romp" with at least 32 coins
562759.Author: KiwiTaco

562760.Title: Funky Diving Maneuvers
562760.Description: In Slimy Spring Galaxy, score at least 15,000 points in "The Chimp's Coin Challenge"
562760.Author: KiwiTaco

562761.Title: I've Got This, Stay Safe
562761.Description: In Bowser's Galaxy Generator, collect the Grand Star "Bowser's Fortified Fortress" without using Yoshi
562761.Author: KiwiTaco

562762.Title: Pixel-Flipper
562762.Description: In Mario Squared Galaxy, collect the Power Star "Make Mario a Star" without pressing the jump button more than once
562762.Author: KiwiTaco

562763.Title: Porphyrophilia
562763.Description: In Rolling Coaster Galaxy, collect all 110 Purple Coins in "Purple Coins on the Rainbow Road"
562763.Author: KiwiTaco

562764.Title: Puzzle Box and Bits
562764.Description: In Twisty Trials Galaxy, collect the Power Star "Turning Turning Double Time" with at least 122 Star Bits and without dying
562764.Author: KiwiTaco

562766.Title: Sprinting Through the Time Stream
562766.Description: In Stone Cyclone Galaxy, collect the first Green Star while time is slowed down
562766.Author: KiwiTaco

562767.Title: Throwback Throwdown Daredevil Run
562767.Description: In Boss Blitz Galaxy, collect the Power Star "Throwback Throwdown" without taking damage
562767.Author: KiwiTaco

562773.Title: Clones Can't Catch Up
562773.Description: In Flip-Out Galaxy, collect the Power Star "Cosmic Clone Wall Jumpers" in under 01:45.00
562773.Author: KiwiTaco

562774.Title: Bringing the Baby All the Way Home
562774.Description: In Grandmaster Galaxy, collect the Power Star "The Perfect Run" with at least one cloud remaining
562774.Author: KiwiTaco
